# brig sandbox attach

Attach a provider to a sandbox

## Synopsis

```text
brig sandbox attach [VM] SANDBOX PROVIDER
```

## Description

Attach a provider to a ready sandbox and wait until the sandbox applies it,
as openshell sandbox provider attach --wait does. Only programs that the
sandbox starts afterwards see the provider's credentials: open a new shell
with [`brig sandbox exec`](brig-sandbox-exec.md), or stop and start the sandbox.

## Examples

```sh
brig sandbox attach dev webapp github
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-w, --workspace string` | the workspace of the gateway to work in (default: $BRIG\_WORKSPACE, else default) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
